name: PM Street Vendor's AtmaNirbhar Nidhi (PM SVANidhi)
description: PM SVANidhi is a Central Sector Scheme aimed at providing affordable working capital loans to street vendors to resume their livelihoods that were adversely affected due to COVID-19 lockdowns.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs

misc_conditions: Must be engaged in street vending in urban areas on or before March 24, 2020
Possesses a valid Certificate of Vending or Identity Card issued by Urban Local Bodies (ULBs) or a Letter of Recommendation (LoR)

benefits.description: Collateral-free working capital loan up to ₹10,000 for the first tranche with interest subsidy of 7% per annum on timely repayment.

documents_required: Certificate of Vending / Identity Card or Letter of Recommendation (LoR) from ULB

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector scheme to provide financial assistance to all landholding farmer families across the country to supplement their financial needs in procuring various inputs related to agriculture and allied activities as well as domestic needs.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

misc_conditions: Must be a landholding farmer family with cultivable landholding in their names
No family member is an institutional landholder
No family member holds or has held constitutional posts
No family member is a former or present Minister, MP, MLA, MLC, Mayor, or District Panchayat Chairperson
No family member is a serving or retired officer/employee of Central/State Government, Ministries, Departments, or PSUs
No family member receives a monthly pension of Rs. 10,000 or more
No family member paid income tax in the last assessment year
No family member is a registered professional practicing as a doctor, engineer, lawyer, chartered accountant, or architect

benefits.description: Financial assistance of Rs. 6,000 per annum provided in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every four months directly into the bank accounts of eligible farmer families.

documents_required: Proof of landholding ownership / Khasra Khatauni documents
Bank Account details linked with Aadhaar

name: Ayushman Bharat Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
description: A national public health insurance scheme providing free access to health insurance coverage for low-income earners (bottom 50% of the population) and all senior citizens aged 70 years and above, covering secondary and tertiary healthcare.
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare

benefits.description: Free secondary healthcare for specialist treatment and tertiary healthcare for hospitalization

name: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban)
description: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana (Urban) is a central government housing initiative in India aimed at providing affordable housing to urban residents.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Poverty Alleviation

benefits.description: Provision of affordable housing infrastructure for the urban population.

name: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Mudra Yojana is a scheme launched by the Government of India to provide loans up to 10 Lakhs to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises.

misc_conditions: Must be a non-corporate, non-farm small or micro enterprise

benefits.description: Collateral-free business loan up to ₹10,00,000 categorized into Shishu (up to ₹50,000), Kishor (₹50,000 to ₹5 Lakhs), and Tarun (₹5 Lakhs to ₹10 Lakhs)

name: Sukanya Samriddhi Account
description: A Government of India backed small savings scheme targeted at parents of girl children to encourage building a fund for their future education and welfare.

misc_conditions: Only one account is allowed per girl child
Parents can open a maximum of two accounts for each of their children, with exceptions allowed for twins and triplets

benefits.description: Interest rate of 8.2% per annum (for Jan-Mar 2024 quarter) along with tax benefits on savings

name: Atal Pension Yojana
description: Atal Pension Yojana (APY), formerly known as Swavalamban Yojana, is a government-backed pension scheme in India targeted at workers in the unorganised sector to provide economic security after retirement.

misc_conditions: Must be a worker in the unorganised sector
Must be enrolled in the National Pension Scheme (NPS)

benefits.description: Government contribution of ₹1,000 per year to each NPS account

name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana is a Government-backed life insurance scheme in India providing coverage of ₹2 lakh in case of death due to any cause, for an annual premium of ₹436.

misc_conditions: Must have a bank account
Must link Aadhaar Card to the participatory bank account

benefits.description: Payment of ₹2 lakh to the nominee in case of death due to any cause

name: Pradhan Mantri Suraksha Bima Yojana
description: A government-backed accident insurance scheme in India providing coverage for accidental death and disability to individuals holding a bank account.

misc_conditions: Must hold a savings bank account with auto-debit facility enabled for premium payment
Death due to suicide, alcohol, or drug abuse is excluded from insurance coverage
Claim is eligible only after 45 days of joining the scheme

benefits.description: Coverage of ₹2 Lakh in case of accidental death or full disability (loss of use in both eyes, hands, or feet)
Coverage of ₹1 Lakh in case of partial permanent disability (loss of use in one eye, hand, or foot)

name: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana
description: Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana is a central government scheme launched in May 2016 to distribute clean cooking energy (LPG connections) to women belonging to Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.
ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas

benefits.description: Distribution of LPG connections to women of Below Poverty Line (BPL) families.

name: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) is a Central Sector scheme that provides financial assistance to landholding farmer families across the country to support their agricultural and domestic needs.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare

misc_conditions: Must own cultivable landholding in their name
No family member is an income tax payer in the last assessment year
No family member holds or held a constitutional post, or is a former/present Minister, MP, MLA, Mayor, or District Panchayat Chairperson
No family member is a serving or retired officer or employee of Central/State Government, PSEs, or regular employee of Local Bodies
No family member is a superannuated/retired pensioner receiving a monthly pension of Rs. 10,000 or more
No family member is a registered professional practitioner such as Doctor, Engineer, Lawyer, Chartered Accountant, or Architect

benefits.description: Direct income support of Rs. 6,000 per annum provided in three equal installments of Rs. 2,000 every four months into the beneficiary bank account.

documents_required: Proof of landholding / Land record details
